The product performed well, especially considering its very reasonable price. Simple, easy to use, a good value.

Excellent price, fast deliver, well packed and appears well made. I used it to pull matuire golden can palms away from fence so they would fall into my yard, it worked great for that. I dodn't think I was anywhere near the claimed 2 tonne capacity, however.

Excellent quality and very sturdy motorcycle shelter! The 600D Oxford fabric is completely waterproof and stands up well to the weather. The frame feels solid, the opening mechanism works smoothly, and the bike fits underneath perfectly. Great value for money!

Contiene perfettamente un Harley Davidson Fat Boy con il parabrezza. Ottima la tela che e molto spessa e impermeabile. Il montaggio e facile e le istruzioni sono comprensibili anche per chi non e ingegnere.

I have been looking for a cover that actually fits my bike appropriately. I have a fully dressed Goldwing, and this is the first Garage style cover that fits my bike properly. Even has a little bit of room to spare. If you have a full bagger, Bike, this is definitely a great cover for it.
Excellent purchase. Totally spacious, my Himalayan 411 fits perfect, and there is more additional space. Assembly instructions need improvement.
this worked perfectly for what I needed. I have 2 motorcycles stored in the shelter. a bit of a pain to build but that’s expected. works great for me.
Good tool thought the handle was longer but that was my mistake. A+

I was surprised how heavy duty this was. I’m a 65 year old female and had no trouble jacking up my zero turn mower to clean under the decking.

Very happy with this ride on maintenance tool. The one thing it lacks is a latch to keep it closed when folded. And also a wheel lock. Otherwise it is a very good buy.

The jack arrived on time and no issues with delivery. Easy to put together and seems good as for it's use. A one person assembly. So glad I purchased it. It was a dreaded task to clean the deck of my zero turn 62 inch riding mower. Takes up minimal space. I would definitely recommend this jack. Easy Easy.
